brief: A bot auto-merges dependency-bump pull requests. Policy: automerge only when the PR is a version bump of a single dependency, touches only lockfiles and manifests (package.json, package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, yarn.lock, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, go.mod, go.sum), and the description does not state that the change is breaking or requires a migration. Otherwise request a human review.
input_shape: { title: string, description: string, files: string[] }

input.title: chore(deps): bump lodash from 4.17.20 to 4.17.21
input.description: Bumps lodash. Release notes: fixes prototype pollution. No breaking changes.

input.title: chore(deps): bump axios from 0.21.4 to 1.0.0
input.description: Major version. Breaking: the default export was removed. See the migration guide.

input.title: chore(deps): bump lodash and minimist
input.description: Bumps lodash to 4.17.21 and minimist to 1.2.6. No breaking changes.

input.title: chore(deps): bump react-dom from 18.2.0 to 18.3.1
input.description: Patch release. Older docs mentioned breaking changes in 18.0, but this release has none and needs no migration.

input.title: chore(deps): bump pino from 8.0.0 to 9.0.0
input.description: Bumps pino. Requires running the new log-format migration script before deploy.
